finding: Partial proof of diagonal cancellation, not of the printed existence of a spectral or geometric smoothening. On the actual idèle class group, the translated product-Haar box (xUₙ)² has mass μ(Uₙ)². For the source support gap above norm 1+ε, ε>0, continuity of the quotient norm and the accepted support lemma in Theorems.IdeleClassConvolutionKernel give pointwise vanishing of φ(y/z) everywhere on each sufficiently small box, at every center x. Thus the normalized product-measure averages of φ(y/z)−k(y,z) eventually equal minus those of k, and either finite limit implies the opposite limit for the other. The exact equality is of Lean totalized averages; the source interpretation uses positive finite box masses and local integrability. The ordinary-import client uses counting quotient Haar and a nonzero constant test kernel with open relatively compact shrinking sets. No spectral representation, almost-everywhere diagonal convergence, nuclearity, or trace identity is established. The accepted rational-radial Hilbert operator lift and bare-kernel receipt distinguish projection after convolution and the missing test-dependent transpose rows; neither supplies a trace-class Haar kernel. The Q(i) box audit in .godel/obligations/trace-spectral.md prevents importing the printed global boxes as generally shrinking or valid trace-diagonal boxes.
retry: For the nondegenerate symmetric base, half twist and fixed norm-one isotype at s=0, identify the actual weighted model and prove trace class of the descended convolution, with its orthogonal lift represented by the corrected transpose-convolution kernel against the same class Haar (not the bare input jets or the weighted-measure density). Supply genuinely shrinking positive finite mass D′ boxes, or prove the needed differentiation for the chosen boxes. Then prove diagonal convergence using a summable rank-one decomposition with a uniform L² bound for the tail-supremum maximal averages of absolute values, or an equally strong diagonal argument, with the continuous weight conversion controlled on these boxes. Product L² convergence or product-a.e. differentiation does not control the product-null diagonal; the later s≥3 singleton-kernel calculation cannot supply the required s=0 result.
